name: PLUNDERERS
text: Not in the first turning point. Roll a D3: up to that many Voidscarreds take a free Dash right now, one after another in the order you pick. Each that does so cannot Dash in its own activation this turning point.

name: PIRATICAL PROFITEERS
text: For the rest of the turning point, a friendly Voidscarred has Balanced on its weapons in any shooting, fight or retaliation where it, or the enemy it faces, is contesting an objective marker or a mission marker of yours.

name: MOBILE ENGAGEMENT
text: Until the turning point ends, a friendly Voidscarred that has already moved during one of its actions this turning point may re-roll one defence die each time it is shot.

name: OUTCASTS
text: For this turning point, a Voidscarred standing more than 5 inches clear of every other friendly operative has Punishing on its weapons.

name: OPPORTUNISTIC FIGHTERS
text: As an enemy starts a Fall Back, before it takes a step: roll 2D3 damage against it once for every friendly Voidscarred within its control range.

name: LIGHT FINGERS
text: Played in a friendly Voidscarred's activation: for the rest of it, enemies in its control range no longer bar it from Pick Up Marker or mission actions. Costs 0 CP on a Warrior.

name: CAPRICIOUS FLIGHT
text: Played between actions in a friendly Voidscarred's activation (or before its first): its Fall Backs cost 1 AP less until that activation ends. Costs 0 CP on a Warrior.

name: CONTEMPTUOUS ADVENTURER
text: As your first Voidscarred of the turning point is activated, if it is more than 5 inches from every other friendly operative: the first time it Shoots or Fights in that activation, its weapons have Relentless for that one action.

name: ERUDITE HUNTER
text: The Kurnite Hunter's own strategic gambit while it is in the killzone, free of CP: pick an enemy within 9 inches of it (see the datacard rule).

name: STAR CHARTS
text: Star Charts equipment, played as a strategic gambit: roll a D3; if it beats the turning point number you gain 1 CP and cannot use it again this battle. A failed roll may be tried again in a later turning point.
